proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F X σ τ N hσ hτ h hb
  have key : ∀ Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ, MeasureTheory.Submartingale Y F P → ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue Y σ ω ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue Y τ ω ∂P := fun Y hY => hY.expected_stoppedValue_mono hσ hτ h hb
  refine ⟨key X, fun hM => le_antisymm (key X hM.submartingale) ?_⟩
  have h2 := key (-X) hM.neg.submartingale
  have e : ∀ π : Ω → WithTop ℕ, ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue (-X) π ω ∂P = -∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue X π ω ∂P := by
    intro π
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    rfl
  rw [e, e] at h2
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (σ τ : Ω → WithTop ℕ) (N : ℕ), MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F σ → MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F τ → σ ≤ τ → (∀ ω, τ ω ≤ N) → (MeasureTheory.Submartingale X F P → ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue X σ ω ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue X τ ω ∂P) ∧ (MeasureTheory.Martingale X F P → ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue X σ ω ∂P = ∫ ω, MeasureTheory.stoppedValue X τ ω ∂P)
